title: Chests, gear levels, community raid boss and expedition scenes
notes: **Chests:** a treasure chest floats up every 5 to 10 minutes while the app is open. Tap it for Marks, Aether and more. The longer since the last chest, the bigger the prize.
**Gear levels:** a duplicate piece of gear raises that piece's level and its stat bonus. There are 17 new pieces, so every affinity has gear. Gear levels count in the Arena too.
**Expeditions:** tap an expedition to watch it live: a real battle, a campfire or a roadside shrine.

**Raids:** the Arena's Raids tab has a community boss. Every player's attempts fill one shared bar, with milestone rewards at 25, 50, 75 and 100%. It needs a connection to the Arena server. When the Fight button is unavailable it now says why, and tapping it explains instead of doing nothing.
**Banner:** a second Marks banner, Blessings and Curses, has a boosted chance at those actions and a pity at 30.
**Power:** affinity, Evade, crit and gear now count toward Power, and unit lists show Power beside the name.
**Combat:** a unit no longer uses a buff or debuff straight after another one. Swapping the whole party no longer stalls a fight.
**Look:** the night and the cave are brighter, and each boss opens a gate to a new environment.
**Performance:** catching up expeditions after time away is spread over frames, so there are no more long hitches.
**Saves:** the save format is now version 3. An older build will refuse to open it rather than lose your gear levels.

title: Dynamic lighting, shadows and quality of life
notes: **Lighting:** the battle now has a sun (or moon) that follows your device's clock: dawn, noon, dusk and night each tint the scene and shade the characters. The cave is lit blue with small lights on its crystals. Turn it off in Settings > Dynamic lighting.
**Shadows:** every unit has a ground shadow. It is an ellipse at noon and grows a soft, pointed tail away from the sun toward dawn and dusk, and it follows the unit when it moves or jumps.
**Frame rate:** Settings > Frame rate lets you choose Default (60), 30, 60, 90 or 120 fps. Only the options your screen can show are listed.
**Expeditions:** collecting expeditions now pops up everything you received.
**Units:** the summary page shows each unit's power at the top, and unit lists can be sorted by power.
**Gear and Lore:** Auto-set gear picks the best gear for a unit by rarity and affinity. Auto-level spreads free Lore evenly across an action's upgrades (never Broad).
**Pulls:** duplicate pulls in the same session now stack on one card (for example "Name x3").
**Combat:** Unravel, a new action, removes a random buff from each enemy it hits. Blind and Confusion now get stronger with Deepening in six steps (Blind tops out at 60%, Confusion at 80%).
**Battle:** the turn order appears half a second sooner. The enrage bar drains while your party runs to the next wave, and the enrage text is larger, bolder and easier to read.
**Loading:** catching up on time away now shows a title screen with a loading bar.
**Notifications:** if Android is blocking notifications or alarms for Farroad, Settings now says so and has a Fix button.
**Fixes:** guards against a rare drawing error, and a frame-rate or lighting choice you made now applies from the first screen on every launch.

title: Pull results, animations and wider windows
notes: **Pulls:** each pull now shows what you got in a box: cards reveal one by one, rarer ones glow, and a duplicate converts in front of you into Lore or Aether. A Skip button sits at the top.

**Gear:** gear is no longer a Marks pull. Pulls give units (5%), actions (50%) and gambits (45%). Gear comes from expeditions (about half of what a party picks up on the road) and from the final stage of each companion quest, which gives one rare piece that suits the unit's affinity. Dungeons no longer give gear. Every affinity now has rare and legendary gear.
**Expeditions:** a party finds something about every 22 waves, and half of those finds are gear.

**Leveling:** a unit that levels up gets a sparkle and a banner. On the Aether screen the level and every stat count up to their new values with a green arrow, and so do Recovery, Evade, crit rates and affinities.
**Live menus:** gaining Aether or a level while a menu is open now updates what you can afford and the levels in the unit list. No need to close and reopen it.
**Summary:** Charge sits beside Recovery, and every number is live: HP shows the unit's real current HP in the fight, and values count up with an arrow when they rise.

**Shop:** buying plays a light that grows from the button. A bought gambit, unit or first copy of an action shrinks away and the rows below move up. Gear and Lore purchases flash and stay. The Lore line now reads "Purchase for +1 Lore".

**Battle:** the turn order slides in with the enemies and shows a sixth action running off the edge. The yellow outline stays put while the queue moves into it. The enrage bar and unit bars ease smoothly, a yellow ripple marks a cleared wave, allies and enemies move at a pace set by their own speed, and units now sit below the top bar.
**Combos:** when a unit acts twice in a row from the same spot, the second attack follows straight away and spells chain faster.
**Status:** actions in the status card have an info button, and its HP and charge bars animate like the ones on the field.
**Lore:** the action's details are behind a Details button next to its name, and the Lore text is blue.
**Leaderboard:** the rank is on the left of the name and the rating on the right, and your own row is highlighted.
**Windows and browser:** the window can be a little wider than a phone, F11 or Alt+Enter toggles full screen, and a window wider than that keeps the game centred with bars at the sides.
**Fixes:** a hurt or dead pose could get stuck or a dead enemy could come back when several attacks landed close together. The ✕ buttons are round again.

title: Shifted Reflection fix
notes: **Fix:** the Shifted Reflection screen no longer has the battle, its effects and the wave text showing through it.

title: Gambits, charge sharing and a legendary mage
notes: **Gambits:** 36 new conditions. Foes can be strong or weak to any affinity (including Body and Spirit); allies and foes can be checked for statuses (poisoned, burning, has a debuff or buff, taunting); whole-party checks (all allies hurt, 2+ hurt, none hurt, last one standing); and charge checks for yourself and your allies.
**New actions:** Kindle gives an ally charge. Tithe shares some of your own charge with the party. Floodgate (charge action) gives every other ally charge. Potent strengthens all three.

**New enemies:** Ironhide Brute, Hollow Husk, Rotted Carrion and Veilwarden, plus two new bosses, Iron Sovereign and Hollow Oracle. Existing enemies were given Body and Spirit strengths and weaknesses.
**New unit:** Lyrael, a legendary Spirit mage.
**Main Character:** growth per level is now at legendary level. Existing characters are updated automatically.
**Shifted Reflection:** reach wave 100 to receive one. Use it from Units, on your Main Character, to spread your stat points again.

**Training:** test your gambits on up to 10 dummies. Open it from the Test button in the Gambits editor or from the Quests tab. Each dummy can be set to any level, have its stats changed, hold statuses, be weak or strong to any affinity, fight back, and can be swapped for any enemy you've met. Nothing in training gives rewards or changes your progress, and you can edit gambits from Units while it runs.

**Arena:** an opponent's actions now show their level. A new rival, The Proving Ground, is a Power 1000 team to test your build against. The Arena needs the latest released version of the game, and says so when yours is out of date.

**Notifications:** Windows now alerts you even when the game is closed, and the browser version can notify you while its tab stays open. Each kind of alert has its own switch, plus a test button. Expedition alerts now arrive exactly when the party is home, and Android asks for the permission it needs to deliver idle alerts on time.
**Fixes:** menus stay open when you switch away from the browser and come back. Waves fought while the game was closed now count in the wave stats.

**New look (preparing for the art pass):** the UI changes in this update are the first step before the new art arrives. Every menu now uses dark brown panels with a silver rim and rounded buttons, in a new, clearer font. Text across the game was made lighter and more vibrant, and names, wave text and enrage text have outlines. Damage numbers are red, and rewards that fly in are outlined.
**Bars:** unit HP and charge bars were redesigned. HP turns green, yellow, then red, charge is orange with step marks, and a pale trail shows the damage you just took.

**Battle pacing:** when several allies (or several enemies) act in a row, each starts 0.25 seconds after the last. Spells now follow their target if it is still moving, and effects, HP and charge no longer pop or jump early.

**Units:** levels now show next to each unit in the Units dropdown and the Party list. Long unit names in the turn order show just the first word. A unit's own self-targeted action, like a Mire Hound's Quickened Howl, plays in place instead of hopping.
**Filters:** the sort and filter options now fit on one line.
**Patch notes and updates:** this window, and a check for new versions, were added to Settings.

title: Ranked Arena and cloud saves
notes: **Arena:** every fight is decided on the Farroad server, so results can't be faked. Your fielded party is your Arena team; others fight it while you're away.
**Ratings** rise and fall after each fight. Opponents near your rating show their Rating and Power, and can be sorted by power, rating or name.
**Leaderboard** shows the top players' ratings, wins and losses. **Records** shows your last 50 fights.
**Cloud saves:** your game is saved to the cloud automatically. Menu > Cloud save & recovery code lets you continue on another phone, PC or the browser.
**Power** now includes gear and Aether investments, and reads the same on the Road and in the Arena.
**Potent** now strengthens revives. Tapping an enemy shows its gambits. Damage over time shows in purple.
